title: One will and one energy condemned
english: I read the Acts of the Sixth Council, in sessions [the number is blank in Bekker], at which Sergius, Cyrus, and Pyrrhus of Constantinople were anathematized, together with Honorius of Rome, Polychronius, and others with them, who had dared to say there was one will and one energy in Christ. They confirmed the dogma of the truth.
translator_notes: Greek locked from Bekker 1824 p.5. Bekker prints lacuna dots after ἐν πράξεσιν.
Codex 19 of 279; Sixth Council = Constantinople III (680-681). Monothelite names as in the Greek.
